# jamfplatform_pro_class (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro class by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `classes:read` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a class by ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_class" "by_id" {
  id = "3"
}

# Look up a class by exact name.
data "jamfplatform_pro_class" "by_name" {
  name = "Biology 101"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Class ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Class display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Class description.
- `mobile_device_group_ids` (Set of String) Jamf Pro mobile device group IDs (as strings) assigned to the class.
- `site_id` (String) Jamf Pro site ID scoping the class. `-1` means no site (`NONE`).
- `site_name` (String) Jamf Pro site display name.
- `source` (String) How the class was created in Jamf Pro.
- `student_group_ids` (Set of String) Jamf Pro user group IDs (as strings) assigned as student groups.
- `student_ids` (Set of String) Jamf Pro user IDs (as strings) for the students, resolved by Jamf Pro.
- `students` (Set of String) Usernames of the students assigned to the class.
- `teacher_group_ids` (Set of String) Jamf Pro user group IDs (as strings) assigned as teacher groups.
- `teacher_ids` (Set of String) Jamf Pro user IDs (as strings) for the teachers, resolved by Jamf Pro.
- `teachers` (Set of String) Usernames of the teachers assigned to the class.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
